name: Directory-Free

sources.title: Directory-Free homepage - 'The Oldest Active Web Directory In The World' (est. 2005)
Submit page - Regular free listing vs Featured listing $4.95 one-time

conditions: Free 'Regular listing' exists but inclusion is NOT guaranteed and review happens 'as and when a reviewer has time'
Free listings appear below all featured listings, get no thumbnail, and carry ads on the listing page

Featured listing ($4.95 one-time) gets 24h approval, dofollow links on category and details pages, top-of-category placement, thumbnail, no ads, and 'Premium Sites' inclusion — refunded if not accepted
requirements: General web directory (not software-specific) — pick the most specific category/sub-category (e.g. Software, Computers/Developers, Internet/SEO Services)
Regular listing: site must be in English; deep links are not allowed (homepage URL only)
Featured listing: site NOT accepted if it is an Escorts, Tobacco, Nicotine, Health or Games site
The featured-listing rules contain an apparent typo: 'The site should not be in English' — likely intended as a language requirement consistent with the regular rules; verify before relying on it
preparation: Homepage URL (no deep links for free submissions)
$4.95 if choosing featured (payment mechanism shown on the submit page)
workflow: Choose Regular (free) or Featured ($4.95 one-time) listing block
Select the category/sub-category from the long list
Free: wait for an editor to get to it (no SLA). Featured: approval within 24 hours, full refund if rejected
watchFor: Inclusion is explicitly not guaranteed on the free tier — the listing may never be reviewed
Ads appear on the listing page for free listings; featured pages are ad-free
Deep links rejected on free tier — submit the homepage
Contradictory language rule on the featured block ('should not be in English') — probably a copy error, but non-English sites should verify first
Old-school directory UI (table layout, PHP pages) — functional but dated; link equity is modest despite the 'oldest directory' claim
countsAsLive: The site appears in its category page listing and gets a view-<slug>-<id>.html details page
unknowns: Whether free listings' links are dofollow (catalog note says follow; featured is confirmed dofollow, free unstated)
Whether an account is needed (submit.php appears to be an open form)
